articles.title: Cardamom markets signal diverging momentum as small cardamom auctions cross Rs 3,600/kg while large cardamom holds firm - AgroSpectrum India
articles.description: Robust auction participation and premium bidding strengthen sentiment in the small cardamom trade; large cardamom markets remain stable across eastern trading centres

articles.title: Regional seminar on large cardamom, king chilli held at Pfuchama - MokokchungTimes.com
articles.description: A regional seminar on large cardamom and king chilli was conducted by the Spices Board, Field Office, Kohima, at Pfuchama Village in Kohima district on August 25.

articles.title: Cardamom exports lose aroma as prices surge - BusinessLine
articles.description: Cardamom exports decline as prices rise, prompting cautious purchasing strategies among importers amid uncertain crop prospects due to monsoon conditions.

articles.title: New cardamom crop fetches Rs. 95,000 per 40 kg - The Rising Nepal
articles.description: The new crop of large cardamom has started fetching Rs. 95,000 per man (40 kg) in Taplejung. The new crop, which began arriving in the market two to three days ago, is being traded at the rate of Rs. 95,000 per man.

articles.title: Amid farmer discouragement from Chirkey losses, Nagaland’s cardamom cultivation picks up - MokokchungTimes.com
articles.description: For the past seven to eight years, Chirkey disease has made large cardamom a difficult crop for many farmers in Nagaland. Ariba Anar, State Coordinator of NERAMAC, estimates that the outbreak seven to eight years ago wiped out 80–90% of production.

articles.title: Cardamom export thru Kakarbhitta rises sharply in last FY - The Rising Nepal
articles.description: According to the Customs Office, cardamom export grew by 64.6 per cent in the last fiscal year compared to the fiscal year 2081/82 BS, when exports stood at Rs 7.67 billion.
